title: Gregfana / Feed
description: Activity per 1-minute bucket, newest first. Built from Prometheus counters: exact order within a minute, coordinates and per-kill targets are not recorded. Column headers have their own filters too.

list.name: action
list.label: Action
list.query: mined,placed,crafted,used,broken,consumed,died,killed mob,killed player,joined,left,produced,used input,produced mB,used input mB

targets.expr: (sum by (name, action, item) (round(increase(gregfana_player_stat_observed{action!="",action=~"${action:regex}",item=~"(?i).*${item}.*"}[1m])) * on(player) group_left(name) gregfana_player_info{name=~"$player"}) or (label_replace(sum by (name, item) (round(increase(gregfana_player_blocks_placed_by_item_total{item=~"(?i).*${item}.*"}[1m])) * on(player) group_left(name) gregfana_player_info{name=~"$player"}), "action", "placed", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "placed", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", ""))) or (label_replace(sum by (name, item) (round(increase(gregfana_player_items_consumed_by_item_total{item=~"(?i).*${item}.*"}[1m])) * on(player) group_left(name) gregfana_player_info{name=~"$player"}), "action", "consumed", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "consumed", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", ""))) or (label_replace(sum by (name, item) (round(increase(gregfana_player_stat_observed{stat="stat.deaths"}[1m])) * on(player) group_left(name) gregfana_player_info{name=~"$player"}), "action", "died", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "died", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", ""))) or (label_replace(sum by (name, item) (round(increase(gregfana_player_stat_observed{stat="stat.mobKills"}[1m])) * on(player) group_left(name) gregfana_player_info{name=~"$player"}), "action", "killed mob", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "killed mob", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", ""))) or (label_replace(sum by (name, item) (round(increase(gregfana_player_stat_observed{stat="stat.playerKills"}[1m])) * on(player) group_left(name) gregfana_player_info{name=~"$player"}), "action", "killed player", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "killed player", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", ""))) or (label_replace(sum by (name, item) (((gregfana_player_online - gregfana_player_online offset 1m) == 1) * on(player) group_left(name) gregfana_player_info{name=~"$player"}), "action", "joined", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "joined", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", ""))) or (label_replace(sum by (name, item) (abs((gregfana_player_online - gregfana_player_online offset 1m) == -1) * on(player) group_left(name) gregfana_player_info{name=~"$player"}), "action", "left", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "left", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", "")))) > 0

((label_replace(sum by (machine, item) (round(increase(gregfana_machine_items_produced_by_resource_total{machine=~"$machine",item=~"(?i).*${item}.*"}[1m]))), "action", "produced", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "produced", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", ""))) or (label_replace(sum by (machine, item) (round(increase(gregfana_machine_items_consumed_by_resource_total{machine=~"$machine",item=~"(?i).*${item}.*"}[1m]))), "action", "used input", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "used input", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", ""))) or (label_replace(sum by (machine, item) (label_replace(sum by (machine, fluid) (round(increase(gregfana_machine_fluid_produced_millibuckets_by_resource_total{machine=~"$machine",fluid=~"(?i).*${item}.*"}[1m]))), "item", "$1", "fluid", "(.*)")), "action", "produced mB", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "produced mB", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", ""))) or (label_replace(sum by (machine, item) (label_replace(sum by (machine, fluid) (round(increase(gregfana_machine_fluid_consumed_millibuckets_by_resource_total{machine=~"$machine",fluid=~"(?i).*${item}.*"}[1m]))), "item", "$1", "fluid", "(.*)")), "action", "used input mB", "", "") and on() (label_replace(label_replace(vector(1), "a", "used input mB", "", ""), "ok", "y", "a", "${action:regex}") and on(ok) label_replace(vector(1), "ok", "y", "", "")))) > 0
